rationale: The agent did look up the user and retrieved order details, then executed both a return (hose, backpack) and an exchange (boots to waterproof) via tool calls. However, there is no evidence of explicit user confirmation before performing these order-changing writes, which violates the stated policy requirement to confirm every action prior to execution. Additionally, the final communication does not provide outcome details (e.g., confirmation of items processed, refund/exchange specifics), nor does it acknowledge both requests together as the user asked. While the actions appear to target the correct user/orders, the lack of confirmation and insufficient final information mean the request was not completed in line with policy.
